text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I managed to run the entire race,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now there is no doubt that I've returned
to full
health. All that remains is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To show everyone that I can run the
Japan Cup
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This is the last of the Classic Triple
Crown races...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've seen firsthand how determined other
racers
are and learned about my
personal shortcomings.
These past six
months have taught me a lot.
choice_data_list: Let's connect all of this to what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. That is the only thing we can
do—move
forward.
